title: HYPOTHESIS TESTING FOR QUANTIFYING LLM-HUMAN MISALIGNMENT IN MULTIPLE CHOICE SETTINGS
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the misalignment between an LLM's simulated multiple-choice survey responses and actual human responses for various demographic subgroups, including specific religious affiliations and levels of religious attendance.
findings: GPT-3.5-Turbo showed significant misalignment with human responses across all tested religious subgroups. The paper notes that groups with high religious attendance exhibited relatively high misalignment scores, indicating the model struggles to accurately replicate the opinions of these subgroups, particularly on contentious survey questions.
references: James Brand, Ayelet Israeli, and Donald Ngwe. Using gpt for market research, 2023.
